run_generate_text: run generate_text to complete a prompt with the LLM and return the completion string
run_generate_content: run generate_content to generate text or multimodal content from a prompt with optional details
run_chat: run chat to generate an assistant reply from a sequence of messages with a chosen formatter
run_instruct: run instruct to ask an LLM assistant to execute instructions provided in the prompt
run_select: run select to choose the best option from a list of candidates using score_text
